A man with dyed blonde hair, glasses, and a brown textured shirt is the central character, holding a white cup and gesturing. A large blue and white stall banner with the text '50' in red is visible. The background is filled with various market stalls, bright artificial lights, and people walking. (2) There is a quick camera cut to a medium shot of a man in a white t-shirt running down a market aisle away from the camera, carrying multiple full plastic bags. The surrounding environment consists of metal carts, food stall equipment, and a grey paved ground under a darkening sky. (3) The visual focus shifts to a food stall with a bright yellow sign for '日式鮮炸魷魚'. Two staff members, an older man in a blue polo and a woman in a grey shirt and mask, are seen behind a counter filled with food photos. The lighting is bright and direct from the stall's internal lamps. (4) A close-up shot features a white banner for '光棍吉拿棒' featuring a cartoon logo of a couple. Another man with black hair and glasses in a white shirt is now visible, looking down at the food. (7) The final phase shows the man in the white shirt taking a large bite of the fish. He looks directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, exaggerated expression of surprise, his mouth full of food. He then nods and continues chewing, while the man in the brown shirt laughs off-camera.
